name: Assistència Sanitària
note: Barcelona-based health insurer, founded in 1957 by Dr. Josep Espriu with the support of the Col·legi de Metges de Barcelona (Crónica Global, 9 September 2026). Front-of-shirt sponsor of FC Barcelona's professional indoor sections (basketball, handball, futsal, roller hockey) since 2019; the basketball team keeps its logo on the shirt in 2026-27 (Culemanía/Crónica Global, 30 August 2026). 78% owned by Autogestió Sanitària, a cooperative of doctors and dentists - the sources name no state or fund in the ownership chain, so the proposed tier is none.
